Key design:
- Canvas 224x288, scaled up with image-rendering: pixelated, centered.
- Fixed timestep: accumulator with dt = 1/60.
- Game states: TITLE, STAGE_INTRO, PLAYING, GAME_OVER, CHALLENGE_INTRO?, CHALLENGING, CHALLENGE_RESULT, PAUSED.
- Player: x position, dual fighter (left/right ship alive), shots (max 2, or 4 in dual? Spec says "fire 2 shots simultaneously (2x width as target)" — dual fighter fires 2 shots, one from each ship; the 2-shot limit probably applies per ship. Allow max 2 shots per ship).
- Enemies: formation slots. Formation: 40 slots. Top row 4 bosses (x positions), rows 2-3: 16 goeis, rows 4-5: 20 zakos.

Row 2 (goei): 8 at x = 28, 42, 56, 70, 84, 98, 112, 126, 140, 154? Actually 16 goeis in 2 rows of 8. Let me use:
Row 2: 8 at x = 28,42,56,70,84,98,112,126? Hmm, need symmetry around center 112. Use offsets: 84, 70, 56, 42, 28 mirrored: 140, 154, 168, 182? That's 8: [28,42,56,70,84,100,116,132]? Not symmetric.

Simpler: center 112. Row 2 x = 112 + [-56,-42,-28,-14,14,28,42,56] = [56,70,84,98,126,140,154,168]. Row 3 similar but shifted: [-49,-35,-21,-7,7,21,35,49] → [63,77,91,105,119,133,147,161]. Row 4 (zako): 10: [-63,-49,-35,-21,-7,7,21,35,49,63] → [49,63,77,91,105,119,133,147,161,175]. Row 5: 10: [-70,-56,-42,-28,-14,14,28,42,56,70] → [42,56,70,84,98,112,126,140,154,168].

Y positions: row 1 y=48, row 2 y=64, row 3 y=80, row 4 y=96, row 5 y=112.

Formation sway: offset = sin(t)*amplitude, amplitude varies (sways larger while filling, breathes when complete).

Entry: enemies fly in along Bezier curves. Implementation: each enemy has a path defined by control points; progress t from 0 to 1 over time; cubic Bezier. Entry groups: bosses first (4 from both sides), then goeis (16 in 2 waves of 8), then zakos (20 in 2 waves of 10). Enemies can fire during entry (rarely).

Diving: enemies leave formation, follow curved path to player, fire. Path: from slot to a point near player, then curve down off-screen; re-enter from top and return to slot. Implement dive path as cubic Bezier: start = current position, cp1, cp2, end = off-screen bottom or near player. Then re-entry path from top to slot.

Boss dive with escorts: when a boss dives, 1-2 goeis accompany (escort flag). Points: 400 alone, 800 with 1, 1600 with 2.

Tractor beam: boss dives partway, stops (state 'tractor'), cone widens. If player is within cone (x range and y below boss), player is pulled up (state 'captured'), turns red, moves to boss, boss returns to formation with captured fighter. Player loses ship, next reserve. If no reserve, game over.

Captured fighter: stored on boss (captured=true). When boss dives and is shot (state diving), captured fighter is released: flies down, docks with player → dual fighter. If boss is shot in formation, captured fighter is destroyed (turns red, flies off, doesn't return).

Dual fighter: player has 2 ships, left/right; each can be hit independently. Hitbox is 2x width. Fires 2 shots.

Challenging stage: stages 3, 7, 11... (stage%4==3). 40 enemies, 5 waves of 8, loop patterns (figure-8 / circles), no firing. Each hit 100 points. 1000 bonus per 8 destroyed, 10000 for perfect. Show "NUMBER OF HITS" and bonus afterward.

 o.connect(g).connect(AC.destination); o.start(t); o.stop(t+dur+0.02);

 for(let i=0;i<n;i++)d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*(1-i/n);
